titleHow.title: ✦ How titles work
titleHow.s1Body:
From the combination of your Sun sign × Moon sign, one of 144 "epithets" is set.
This one is uniquely yours — the diagnosis never changes it.
titleHow.s2Body:
As you answer the PART 1 (everyday) and PART 2 (destiny) questions by choosing cards on intuition, points are added to five axes (Power, Mind, Spirit, Shadow, Heart).
Your highest-scoring axis becomes your "temperament".
titleHow.s3Body: Across the 4 court-card questions, whichever of page, knight, queen, king you pick two or more times becomes your court. If they're scattered, it becomes "mixed".
titleHow.s4Body: 5 axes × 5 courts = 25 kinds of class (Knight, Sage, Astrologer, Ninja…), from which the one class that fits you is chosen.
titleHow.s5Body:
Tap the result screen to flip between the front (Light) and back (Shadow).
Light is your strengths; Shadow is a humor-tinged "oh, that's so me".
titleHow.s6Body:
When axes or courts tie, one is chosen from your Sun sign × Moon sign (144 combinations).
The real lead is the cards you chose — pick different cards and you get a different result.
The astrological seed only plays "the final tiebreaker for when the judge is stuck".
titleHow.footer: * You can take the diagnosis again anytime. Temperament moves with the mood of the day — enjoy it as a mirror reflecting "the you of now".

titleHist.clearBody:

titleHist.guideIntro: Here, the changes in the "title (class)" you diagnosed in the Sanctuary are recorded, newest first.
titleHist.guideClassEpithet:
· Epithet … the name drawn from your Sun sign × Moon sign that stays with you for life.
· Title (class) … "the you of now", shaped by your answers. It changes through re-diagnosis as your inner life and circumstances shift.
titleHist.guideRediagnose:
You can retake it from "Retake the diagnosis" in the Sanctuary.
· Free … up to once
· Cosmic Pro … as many times as you like (even daily)
Retake it at moments of change, and your history stacks up here so you can trace the path of your growth.
titleHist.guideStance: We never weaken a past title as "you used to be…". Every title stands equally, as the you of that moment.

guide.lead: With Cosmic Pro, you can receive your title again as many times as you like.
guide.body1: That said, the "epithet" drawn from your Sun and Moon signs never changes. What changes is only the "title (class)" shaped by your answers to the questions.

guide.body3: Of course, you're welcome to retake it every day. We simply mention, gently, that this too is one way to use it.

usage.title: How to read today's movement
usage.summary:
On this screen, matched to the purpose you intend,
you can read "when to act" — guidance on timing.
usage.vpBody:
The dropdown on the right is the "reference point."
You can choose your birthplace (the point you registered as your current address)
or a point you registered as a VIEWPOINT.
This screen shows where and when the planets reach each "sky direction"
in the sky above your chosen reference point.
usage.diffTitle: [⚠ Different from the Map screen's directions]
usage.diffBody:
· Map screen = "surface directions" (16 directions)
　which way along the ground you head from the reference point
　(going to a land in the east / heading to a land in the north — geography)

· This screen = "sky directions" (4 angles)
　where a planet sits in the sky right above the reference point
　(eastern horizon / overhead zenith / western horizon / straight below)

Even the same "east" means "a land in the east" on the Map,
and "the eastern horizon (where a planet rises)" on this screen.
usage.timeBody:
It shows the times today when each planet passes the 4 sky directions (angles)
in the sky above your chosen reference point:

· ASC (eastern horizon) — the moment a planet rises
· MC  (overhead = zenith) — the moment a planet passes its highest point
· DSC (western horizon) — the moment a planet sets
· IC  (straight below = underground) — the moment a planet is on the far side of the Earth

You can read guidance on the time to act — "when a love theme moves," "when a turning point at work comes," and so on.
usage.comboBody:
The strength of the energy in each surface direction
can be checked from the Map's score bar (16 directions).
There's a detailed explanation in the i button under the "Total / Overall" label.

Combine the score bar (the strength of surface directions) with
this screen (sky direction × time), and Solara works out
the best "direction × time" for the future you wish for.

usage.title: How to use the Map
usage.dirBody:
Centered on your reference point (VIEWPOINT), it scores and shows the energy of each of the 16 surface directions
(N, NNE, NE, ENE, E…).
You can judge "which land or direction to turn your attention toward."

It isn't only a display of which way to go.
Going toward a direction is, of course, one action you can take toward it. But there's also turning your attention there, calling out, placing a cherished item to match the direction as you leave home, being mindful of the direction you face when you speak, which seat you take in a shop and which way you turn, the direction you take a deep breath — you are free to decide.
Through the action you choose, the planets' energy will reach you.
The planets are always watching over you, from a vast vantage point.

Tap the score bar to switch category
(Overall → Healing → Abundance → Love → Work → Talk).
Choose the category you want, and you'll see which directions that energy comes through most strongly.
usage.regPre: You can register a reference point from the
usage.regPost:
(VIEWPOINT) button on the left of the map screen.
Show the place you want at the center of the map, open the panel, and tap "Save this point" — that point is then saved as a VIEWPOINT.

You can switch between your saved reference points anytime, from the top of the search results or the dropdown inside the "Daily" chip in the bottom menu.
usage.findBody: Search for shopping, a meeting spot, a shop, and so on from the search button, and you can check which planets that point is receiving energy from right now.
usage.timeBody:
From the "Daily" chip in the bottom menu you can read "guidance on the time to act."
* The "Daily" chip screen deals with "sky directions" (where and when a planet comes in the sky); it's separate from this Map's "surface directions" (which land to head toward).

Combine the score bar (the strength of surface directions) with the "Daily" chip (sky direction × time), and Solara works out the best "direction × time" for the future you wish for.

catPlanets.title: Categories and their planets
catPlanets.intro:
Each category extracts the aspects of its related planet pairs and scores them per direction, with pair weighting applied.
(How the pair weighting works is explained in detail below.)
catPlanets.weightBody:
A category's score extracts the aspects of its related planet pairs and sums them, weighted by each pair's "centrality."

· Lead pair (weight 2.0)
　The planet pair that carries the category's central theme.
　e.g. Love = Venus×Mars / Work = Saturn×Sun
　→ when the aspect appears, it counts with 2× the influence.

· Sub pair (weight 0.5)
　An aspect where only one of the planets relates to the category.
　e.g. for Love, "Venus×Jupiter" (only Venus carries love)
　→ counts with a modest 0.5× influence.

· Outside the pair (weight 0)
　An aspect where neither planet relates to the category.
　→ it isn't reflected in that category's score.

This "weighting" yields a precise score that reflects the category's "central theme."
A plain sum without pair weights would blur each category's character, so we refine it with weighted calculation.
catPlanets.overallBody:
When "Overall" is selected on the top score bar, the number is the straight sum of all planets and all aspects.
No category weighting is applied (= no pair weights).

The per-category views (Healing / Abundance / Love / Work / Talk), on the other hand, apply the pair weights above.
And a single aspect can be counted in more than one category
(e.g. Venus×Jupiter → counts for both Love and Abundance).

So "the plain sum of the 5 categories ≠ Overall."
The two are numbers for seeing energy from different angles; neither is more correct.
· Per-category = see the category's "concentration"
· Overall = see the "total volume"

events.title: About the moon events
events.intro:
Through this cycle, in step with the moon's waxing and waning,
three turning points come to you.
events.newBody:
The starting point — on the new moon, you set an "intention."
You put into words what you want to hold dear this cycle.
Everything begins here.
events.fullBody:
On the full moon, a midway check-in on the intention you set (a look back).
* It won't appear unless you set an intention at the new moon.
events.catBody:
Arriving the day before the next new moon or later — the close of the cycle.
A letting-go, and the forming of a constellation that is yours alone.
* This, too, assumes you set an intention at the new moon.
events.notifyBody:
Each event visits on "that day" only.
Turn notifications on in Sanctuary,
and we'll let you know the morning of.

The full moon and catasterism assume a new-moon intention,
so the main thing is not to miss the new moon.

guide.title: What is the Galaxy screen?
guide.intro:
In step with the moon's cycle (about 29.5 days),
your daily tarot readings
are recorded here as "stars."

One cycle = one constellation completed.
The rhythm of your inner life remains, in the shape of a constellation.
guide.cycleBody:
Shows where you are now in this moon cycle.
The "dots" of your daily readings line up along a spiral,
advancing toward completion.

· Top-right number: which day of the cycle (e.g. 23 of 30)
· Top-left moon badge: today's phase (← you are here)
· Drag to rotate in 3D
· Tap a dot to see that day's reading
· On new- and full-moon days, a special overlay
　invites you to set or look back on your intention
guide.atlasBody:
A collection of completed past cycles (= constellations).
Each one is a constellation your own inner life has woven.

· Each card is a constellation woven from one cycle of readings
· Tap a card to replay it + see details
　(name, period, rarity)
· Rarity: a 5-level star rating (★)
　the higher the rarity, the rarer the combination that appeared
guide.meaningBody:
🌑 New moon → a beginning. A time to plant seeds.
🌕 Full moon → fulfillment and release. A time of awareness.

Over one cycle, your inner life becomes a single constellation.
Draw your daily card on the Tarot tab,
and let it grow, slowly.

usage.title: How to use FORECAST
usage.intro:
This shows the rhythm of your stars over the year ahead (365 days).
You can take in each day's overall and per-category scores at a glance,
and see ahead of time which days move easily and which call for care.
usage.s1Body:
A 12-month × 31-day grid colors each day by its score.
Change how it reads with the mode (relative / absolute /
category), the color direction (🟢 high /
🔴 high), and the rank (#1 / #2).
See the i button to the right of the heatmap for more.
usage.s2Body:
Tap a day on the heatmap and that day's directional score
and per-category ranking appear below.
usage.s3Body:
Shows each category's "seasons" (a season of connection /
abundance / healing, and so on). Only ongoing stretches that
arrive from today onward. A compass for longer-term plans.
usage.s4Body:
Shows the top 5 days per category — for pinpointing
"when to act" in the short term.
usage.s5Title: [How this relates to the Map numbers]
usage.s5Body:
The FORECAST numbers and the numbers on the Map for the same day
won't match — they're different calculations.

· FORECAST = computed from your birth data alone.
　Wherever you are on Earth, whatever the hour, it doesn't change —
　it traces the energy flowing through you across a whole year.

· Map = computed from where you are now + this very moment.
　Because it includes the ASC (horizon) and MC (zenith),
　the numbers change as the place changes, and even the same day
　reads differently at 12:00 and 19:00
　(the ASC moves about 15°/hour).

Neither is right or wrong — they're two lenses reading the same you
from different angles.
· Use FORECAST to catch the "times that move easily,"
· Use the Map to read "that place, that hour" in detail.
Use them together that way.

heatmapInfo.title: How to read the 1-year heatmap
heatmapInfo.s1Body:
■ Relative mode (default)
Normalized from the year's low → high.
The relatively higher days among your 365 show brighter.
It maximizes the day-to-day contrast.

■ Absolute mode
Colors by the absolute score. Low values are dark,
high values are bright. Use it when comparing across
years or with other people.

■ Category mode
Colors each day by its strongest category:
　🟢 Healing　🟡 Abundance　🩷 Love
　🔵 Work　🟣 Talk

A stretch of the same color is a time when that category's
"wave" is rolling in.
· 🩷 in a row → a season of connection (relational energy flows)
· 🟡 in a row → a season of abundance
· 🟢 in a row → a season of healing
· 🔵 in a row → a season of work
· 🟣 in a row → a season of expression

These "seasons" are also listed with start and end dates in the
"Your star cycles" section below
(only stretches of 7 days or more).
heatmapInfo.s2Body:
Active in "relative" and "absolute" modes.
· 🟢 high: high score = green, low score = red
· 🔴 high: high score = red, low score = green (inverted)

To avoid any good/bad verdict, you choose for yourself
which color direction you want to see.
heatmapInfo.s3Body:
Active in "category" mode.
· #1: paints with the day's strongest category color
· #2: paints with the second-strongest category color

Checking both reveals the "lead" and the "support"
within a single day.
heatmapInfo.footer:
* Even for the same day, this is a different measure from the number you'd open on the Map
(a calculation independent of place and time).
For details, see "How this relates to the Map numbers" under the ❓ button at the top.

cycles.title: Your star cycles
cycles.hint: Shows stretches arriving from today onward (7+ days running)
cycles.empty: No stretches arriving from today onward
cycles.s1Body:
Over the year ahead, it shows the "stretches" where each category's
(Love / Abundance / Healing /
Work / Talk) energy flows strongly.

e.g. "💗 Season of love 6/15 – 7/2 (18 days)"
　 → from 6/15 to 7/2, relational energy
　   runs strong without a break
cycles.s2Body:
· Only stretches arriving from today onward
　(past stretches are hidden)
· Counted as a "stretch" only when strong for 7+ days running
　(short waves aren't shown)

delta.infoBody:
The star lines of astrocartography move moment by moment as the Earth turns.
The "angle lines"—where a planet sits directly overhead or on the horizon—travel about 7.5° in ${m} minutes: roughly 800 km westward at mid-latitudes.

So even in the same place, the lead of the moment can quietly change between the time you chose and ${m} minutes later. Mars's line drawing away, Venus's line drawing near—knowing that shift in advance lets you see how to use your time there: the heart of it early on, or warming toward the end.

We read this not as fortune, good or bad, but as a shift in the quality of the energy. You can see it when you set a time with Cosmic Pro · Outing.

consultResult.deltaInterpNote: Stella shows this shift 30 minutes later as one interpretation, with the line movements above as its evidence. If anything feels off, widen the reading with your own sense of it. What you see here is no more than one interpretation among many.

about.title: What is Stella Consultation?
about.intro:
Just choose "when, where, and what you'll do." Solara lays a planet-scale star map over that plan and reads the energy that works on you at that time and place — it's the heart of Solara.
The vast celestial calculations an astrologer would normally take a long time to read, Stella performs in an instant, and hands to you in words that stay close to you rather than in technical jargon.
about.bullets:
• It maps "where and what you do, and what effect it draws out," in the light of your wish.
• No good/bad verdicts, no rankings. Rather than "good/bad," it tells you what quality of flow it is — a quality that gives you a push, or one that invites you to face something.
• Outings, travel, migration — to match the scale. With Cosmic Pro you can set the time in one-hour steps, and even read how the flow of a place shifts 30 minutes later.
about.dataIntro: Solara's star-line calculation is 10 planets × 4 angles (ASC · MC · DSC · IC) × 3 aspects (conjunction · square · trine / sextile) = 120 lines per frame. It layers several frames and calculates latitude bands, the 12 houses, and progressions.
about.freeHead: — Even with Outing / Event (Free), it goes this far —
about.freeList:
• The 10 planets of the birth chart (natal) / the 10 transiting planets of today
• Astrocartography (Astro*Carto*Graphy / the lines of your birth)
• Cyclocartography (Cyclo*Carto*Graphy / the moving lines of this very moment)
• All aspect lines — conjunction, square, trine, sextile (theme planets × 4 angles × 3 aspects)
• Zenith and nadir bands (latitude energy bands)
• Relocation for that land (the reshuffling of ASC / MC / the 12 houses + which house each theme planet falls in)
• Inner seasons (the progressed Moon and Sun, the turning points of the solar arc) / local timing (the times planets cross the angles)
…Stella overlays all of this across candidate points worldwide and maps the places and directions that resonate with your wish.
about.proList:
• Migration scale = the lifelong, unchanging natal ACG + the life-chapters of progression
• Travel scale = the moving lines for each travel day (sampling several days of the period)
• Set the time in one-hour steps → even how the lines move 30 minutes later
about.devBody: This level of detail is possible because I — someone who has practiced astrology myself — handle everything directly, from design to development. Rather than asking someone else to "please read it this way here," an astrologer gives it form directly; so the meaning of the stars can dwell in every small detail. May this star map stay close beside your every day.

guide.title: How to use ASTRO*CARTO*GRAPHY / CYCLO*CARTO*GRAPHY
guide.jimLewis: — The celestial map upon the Earth, left to us by Jim Lewis —
guide.acgBody:
A method systematized by the astrologer Jim Lewis in the 1970s.
It projects the planetary positions at your birth as "lines" on a world map,
showing which planet rises in which land
(a map that never changes throughout your life).
guide.ccgBody:
An evolution Jim Lewis systematized in 1982 as a sequel to ACG.
Instead of your birth moment, it projects the planetary positions of "this very moment" or a time you specify. The lines move with Earth's rotation,
and the starscape rewrites itself moment by moment.
Solara's Transit / Prog / S.Arc frames
correspond to this CCG.
guide.framesBody:
• Natal … positions at birth (ACG, unchanging for life)
• Transit / Prog / S.Arc … positions that move with time (CCG)

The i button beside each pill has a detailed explanation of each.
guide.linesBody:
Shows planet × angle lines and zenith / nadir markers.
Tap a line or marker to see the meaning of that point
and a message specific to the planet.
The i button beside each pill (angle / zenith / nadir)
has a detailed explanation.
guide.proBody:
• Aspect lines (120): adds square / trine / sextile
　to the main lines
• Relocate: treat the tapped point as a relocation destination and
　compare the moving star lines, ASC/MC, and houses
• Zenith band / Nadir band: Lewis-style band display that applies around the whole latitude

All are unlocked with Cosmic Pro.
guide.usageBody:
For choosing destinations for travel, moving, or business trips.
Even the same action flows with different energy depending on the land. Layer on the 16-direction scores (the directional-energy fan), and "where" and "when" rise together upon the map and the clock.

help.title: VIEWPOINT and LOCATIONS
help.vpBody:
The reference point (observation point) for calculating directional scores.
The map draws how each planet's energy descends across the 16 directions as seen from here.

It's used in the dropdown at the top of the search-results list, and in the VIEWPOINT switcher on the Daily chip screen.
help.locBody:
Points shown as markers on the map
(a list of places you visit often).
Once registered, the marker stays on the map,
so you can see how places relate to each other at a glance.

Tapping the "LOCATIONS" tile button at the bottom
of the Map screen lets you see, in a list,
the energy scores of your LOCATIONS (registered places)
as viewed from the VIEWPOINT.
Register the places you visit often, and you'll see
things like "this park has a high Healing score today" or
"this café has a high Love score today" —
a handy way to see how strong today's energy is
at each registered place.
help.registerBody:
Both VIEWPOINT and LOCATIONS can hold up to 5 entries each
(including your home 🏠).
Your home is placed in the first slot automatically from your profile,
so you can add up to 4 more.

Show the place you want to save at the center of the map,
then tap "Save this point" on the VIEWPOINT tab,
or "Register this point" on the LOCATIONS tab,
to save it to the current tab.
help.iconNameBody:
From the ⋯ button at the right of each slot, open the submenu
to change the name and the icon.
You can choose from 32 icons.
help.reorderBody:
Also in the ⋯ menu, use ↑ ↓ to reorder.
Slots higher up appear earlier in the list.
(Your home 🏠 is fixed at the top and can't be moved or deleted.)

diff.q: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
diff.a:
Stella Consultation goes from 3 / week on Free to 100 / week on Pro; Star Reading goes from "Overall" only on Free to all 5 categories on Pro; aspect lines increase from 40 on Free to 120 on Pro. Tarot is once a day on both plans, but Pro adds no credit cost when you choose a category, plus a question field.

The 4 ACG / CCG frames, search and filter for the Star Atlas and tarot history, and saving and sharing your interpretations are all available on Free too. Please see the table above for details.

weeklyCap.q: What happens if I exceed the weekly cap for Stella Consultation?
weeklyCap.a: You can keep going by purchasing additional credits. On Pro, your 100 / week are replenished at the Monday reset.

proTarot.q: What changes with Tarot on Pro?
proTarot.a:
Tarot is once a day on both Free and Pro. On Pro, you can choose the category you want to ask about (Overall · Love · Abundance · Work · Talk · Healing · Change) and draw a reading without spending any credits. You can also type what you'd like to know as a direct question, and the reading responds to it.

On Free, only Overall is free (once a day); other categories cost 1 credit each time.

outing30min.q: What does "changes 30 minutes later" mean in outing consultations?
outing30min.a:
With Cosmic Pro, you can set the time of an outing or event consultation in one-hour steps. The star lines of astrocartography (CCG) move with Earth's rotation, so even in the same place the "lead star of the moment" quietly changes within 30 minutes.

Opening "View 30 minutes later" on the result screen lets you read the shift in advance — Mars's line drawing away, or Venus's line drawing near. You begin to see how to use your time in that place, such as "the heart of it comes early" or "it warms up toward the latter half" (this is not good or bad fortune, but a shift in the quality of energy).

upgradeDowngrade.q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
upgradeDowngrade.a: You can change it anytime from the subscription management screen in the Apple App Store or Google Play. If you cancel auto-renewal, you'll switch to the Free plan automatically from your next billing date.

afterCancel.q: What happens to features after I cancel?
afterCancel.a: You can keep using Cosmic Pro features until your current billing period ends. After it ends, you'll move to the Free plan automatically. Your history of interpretations stays saved on your device.

resubscribe.q: If I resubscribe to Pro, do my weekly credits increase?
resubscribe.a:
No. Weekly credits are managed per account and reset every Monday. Even if you cancel Pro and resubscribe right away, your remaining count at that moment doesn't change. This isn't about misuse — it simply means resubscribing can't be used as a loophole to repeatedly top up the "100 / week" allowance.

Example: if you cancel Pro on a Wednesday with 0 weekly credits left and resubscribe immediately, the remaining count stays at 0. It returns to 100 the following Monday.

declineDialog.title: Consent is required to use Solara
declineDialog.body:
To use Solara, you'll need to agree to what's described in "Before You Begin." Without your consent, the app can't be used.

Please take another look, or feel free to uninstall Solara. At this point we have not received any of your data, including any personal information, so you can uninstall with complete peace of mind.

intro.heading: ◆ Welcome
intro.body:
Solara gathers the vast data of the cosmos into one place. Behind a single moment, read through astrology, lies an enormous wealth of data. Solara hands that wealth to you as material to reflect on — a genuinely useful companion.

The text and data Solara generates are laid out as evidence, and what you read is offered as one interpretation drawn from that evidence.

Because evidence can be read in many ways, what Solara offers is only one example among many. If something in the words feels off to you, return to the evidence and add your own reading. I would be glad if you used Solara's data to explore astrology in your own way.

I built this app as a practicing astrologer. My wish is that your life shines in a way that is wholly your own.
I am praying for your happiness. I'm grateful that we met through this app. Thank you.

— From the maker of Solara

entertainment.heading: ◆ Solara is for entertainment and self-discovery
entertainment.body:
All of the following features in Solara are means for entertainment and self-discovery:

• Astrology such as birth charts, transits, and progressions
• Drawing and interpreting tarot cards
• Consultations with Stella
• Star readings
• Astrocartography on the map and directional energy scores

They are not professional medical, legal, financial, or psychological advice, and they do not predict or guarantee future events.

thirdParty.heading: ◆ Data sent to third parties
thirdParty.body:
To provide its service, Solara sends data to the following third parties:

• Apple / Google — for abuse prevention (device attestation). Attestation data is sent.
• Google Gemini AI — to generate astrology-based interpretations and tarot interpretations. Your birth details (date, time, and place of birth) and the text you enter in consultations are sent.
• RevenueCat — for purchase management. An anonymous ID and purchase information are sent.

geminiContent.heading: ◆ Content generated by Gemini AI
geminiContent.body:
Solara uses Google's Gemini AI to generate text in the following features:

• Tarot — interpretations of the cards you draw
• Stella Consultation — astrological interpretations in response to your questions
• Star Reading — interpretations across five categories (Love / Abundance / Work / Talk / Overall)
• Relocation (map) — astrological interpretations for the point you select on the map

decisions.heading: ◆ About important decisions
decisions.body:
Solara's interpretations are reference material for understanding yourself. At times they may be inaccurate, or may not fit you.

If a result feels off, please don't take it at face value. For life's important decisions — moving, changing jobs, marriage — please rely on your own judgment and on talking with family and professionals.

For details on how your data is handled, please see below.

consentHandling.heading: ◆ How your consent is handled
consentHandling.body:
When you tap "Agree and Begin," the fact that you agreed to what's described in "Before You Begin" is recorded on your device. It won't be shown again. (If the terms change, we may show this notice once more.)

If you do not agree, please tap "Decline" at the bottom of the screen and uninstall Solara. At this point, we have not received any of your data, including any personal information.
